menu.name: The Midnight Sultan Shawarma
menu.description: Slow-roasted chicken carved straight from charcoal spits, dressed in Lebanese garlic toum, tahini drizzle, and crunchy house pickles wrapped in toasted rumali.

menu.name: Cheesy Lava Charcoal Shawarma
menu.description: Tender juicy chicken drenched in liquid cheddar cheese and fiery peri-peri sauce, griddled with garlic butter until blistered and golden.

menu.name: Smoky BBQ Pulled Chicken Wrap
menu.description: Wood-smoked succulent chicken tossed in dark hickory BBQ glaze with caramelized onions, crispy lettuce, and creamy ranch drizzle.

menu.name: Spicy Paneer Tikka Shawarma
menu.description: Fresh malai paneer cubes marinated in tandoori spices and charred over coals, wrapped with mint toum, sliced bell peppers, and sumac onions.

menu.name: Falafel Hummus Supreme Roll
menu.description: Crispy golden chickpea falafels nestled inside silky house-made hummus, diced parsley salad, pickled turnip, and creamy tahina sauce.

menu.name: The Beirut Monster Meat Roll (XL)
menu.description: 300 grams of succulent charcoal chicken and lamb shavings, double cheese, french fries inside, drenched in our secret spicy garlic sauce.

menu.name: Arabian Shawarma Rice Platter
menu.description: Fragrant golden butter-cumin basmati rice crowned with generous charcoal chicken, crisp fries, warm pita triangles, house salad & rich garlic toum.

menu.name: Grand Mezze & Hummus Platter
menu.description: Silky extra virgin olive oil hummus, crispy falafel pucks, smoked moutabal eggplant dip, fattoush salad, pickled turnip & 2 warm pita breads.

menu.name: Nights Charcoal Mixed Grill Platter
menu.description: Chicken seekh kebabs, charcoal chicken tikka, shawarma shavings, grilled tomatoes, spicy pita and 3 signature dips.

menu.name: Shawarma Loaded Animal Fries
menu.description: Golden crunchy crinkle fries smothered in molten cheddar sauce, minced charcoal chicken, spicy garlic toum, and sliced jalapeños.

menu.name: Fiery Peri-Peri Crinkle Fries
menu.description: Thick crinkle cut potatoes tossed vigorously in our house blend African bird-eye chilli dust. Served with creamy garlic dip.

menu.name: Truffle & Parmesan Herb Fries
menu.description: Crisp shoestring fries perfumed with white truffle oil, dusted with freshly grated aged parmesan cheese and rosemary herbs.

menu.name: Devil's Hot Charcoal Wings (6 Pcs)
menu.description: Double fried crunchy wings glazed in sizzling habanero butter hot sauce, sprinkled with toasted sesame and served with blue cheese dip.

menu.name: Honey Glazed Garlic Wings (6 Pcs)
menu.description: Crispy golden batter chicken wings drenched in sticky wild honey garlic reduction with cracked black pepper.

menu.name: Midnight Craving Duo Box
menu.description: 2x Midnight Sultan Shawarmas + 1x Peri-Peri Loaded Fries + 2x Chilled Mint Mojitos or Cokes. Complete late-night feast.

menu.name: Midnight Solo Champion Box
menu.description: 1x Cheesy Lava Shawarma + 1x Regular Salted Fries + 1x Refreshing Chilled Soft Drink.

menu.name: Electric Blue Mint Lagoon Mojito
menu.description: Muddled fresh Persian mint, fresh lime wedges, blue curacao infusion, topped with fizzy lemon soda over crushed ice.

menu.name: Creamy Nutella Hazelnut Shake
menu.description: Thick full-cream vanilla gelato blended with genuine Nutella, roasted hazelnuts, and topped with chocolate swirl whipped cream.

reviews.name: Sameer S.
reviews.comment: The garlic toum is LEGENDARY. Ordered at 3 AM and the roll arrived piping hot with that authentic smoky charcoal crunch. Unmatched!

reviews.name: Ananya R.
reviews.comment: Best delivery packaging ever. The Saj bread was still crispy and the cheesy lava filling was oozing absolute perfection. 10/10 would reorder.

reviews.name: Rohan M.
reviews.comment: The Duo Box is insane value — 2 massive rolls, loaded fries AND mojitos for ₹399? Weekend movie nights are permanently sorted now.
